summary: Independently verified all 6 Shred Legend fixes + Jam Session regression. (1) Crowd renders exactly 7 distinct characters in order: finn-danger (shark/bass), chunk (drummer), jazzy (pink-punk rat), charlie (frog-captain), lou (llama), stew (parrot), dr-jellybone (octopus) — no duplicate sharks and sizes are reasonably similar (widths 45-150px, heights 112-140px, all within same visual band, none ballooning 2x). (2) Meter rose gradually from 0% to 26.82% during a 2.5s hold on guitar-note-4 (slower than before, matches the ~8%/s + onset bonus target; no instant jump). (3) Song name HUD renders correctly — observed '♪ SURF RIOT' on this play (songIndex rotation confirmed since prior iteration saw 'GARAGE STOMP'). (4) No console/runtime errors on start; game loop runs, timer decrements (40s observed), backing track does not crash. (5) BEND bar (data-testid='guitar-bend') is present in Notes mode and ABSENT in Chords mode where chord grid (data-testid='guitar-chord-grid') appears instead; pressing bend bar + keyboard 'b' both work without errors; bend is restored when switching back to Notes. (6) Jam Session regression at #/free-play: guitar-instrument renders, Chords/Notes/Clean/Crunch toggles all work, BEND bar visible in Notes mode, note pads play without errors. Only console noise: pre-existing unrelated 'empty string passed to src' React warning and 'duplicate key' warning (both pre-existing, flagged in prior iterations).

issues: Jazzy character renders noticeably narrower (~46px wide vs 100-150 for others) because her sprite is tall/thin. Heights are consistent so not a size bug, but visually she looks skinnier than the rest — consider slight horizontal scale bump for Jazzy if a tighter visual match is desired. Not a functional defect.

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing 'empty string passed to src' React warning appears on free-play — some is rendering with src='' before data loads. Minor but worth guarding with conditional render / null src.
Pre-existing 'two children with same key' warning persists app-wide (noted in iteration_25). Unrelated to Shred Legend fixes.
